# llms.txt for ctxvm Trace Corpus
# Derived per ODPS KB recommendation: "How to use ODPS spec with LLMs.txt?"
# Generated by `ctxvm export --odps`, hosted at hub root, referenced from
# dataAccess.agent.specsURL.

## Purpose
Versioned, checksummed corpus of xCABI agent-session traces (pages, renders, evictions,
faults) plus benchmark suites and golden conformance vectors. Every trace replays
byte-identically by design — usable for paging policy research and agent-memory evaluation.
First seed drop (M1, in-repo at `corpus/m1/`): five schema-validated, replay-divergence-free
traces, provenance-labeled (2 reference vectors · 2 tracer-generated · 1 adapter-spike).

## Auth
- Method: none (corpus is open data)
- Upstream product IDs own their own auth if published privately

## Input Format
HTTP(2) file download; JSONL events, one JSON object per line:
- page: `page_id{logical_ref, content_hash}, kind∈[file|tool_result|summary|image_ref], tokens`
- session envelope: `session.open {agent, model, provider, budget, tokenizer}`

## Output Format
File responses: corpus JSONL (zstd) + SHA-256 checksum + conformance vectors.
Consumers MUST verify checksums before replay; replay = byte-identical re-render (xCABI
invariant). Divergence ⇒ report as issue with trace checksum.

## Example Query
GET /corpus/0.1/corpus.jsonl.zst
GET /corpus/0.1/conformance.jsonl
GET /catalog/odpc.yaml

## Limits
- No rate limits (static hosting)
- Releases ≤1/week; offsets released as v0.1+ε drops

## Related standards
- ODPS 4.1 (packaging) | ODPC 1.0 (catalog) | MCP (agent access) | xCABI 0.1 (content)
